nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule

avis.texte: This product does not work for me, im trying to repair my barrier..can you guess why it doesnt work? Yes the niacinamide!! My skin's tightness and stingy tingle feeling from my damaged barrier comes back within seconds even before applying moisturizer which didnt relieve it. So beware if your skin does not like niacinamide…not safe for rosacea.

I have been using this since about 20 weeks on my belly and other areas to try and prevent stretch marks/itchiness. At 32 weeks I've yet to notice any, but I mostly use it for the moisturizing properties. (Stretch marks can be genetic and I'm totally fine/think they're beautiful should I develop them). It just feels extra pampering throughout this time which is why I love it! The price is also very fair for the quality of the product.

I bought this on a whim because I needed s replacementnfor my previous favorite serum/ampoule that has gotten hard to find and I am OBSESSED. This is genuinely the best my skin has ever looked and felt.
I purchased this serum to help relieve irritation on my face from an allergic reaction. Wow, this product is amazing: soothing, moisturizing & repairing.

This is one of my favorite skincare products ever. Ive been using it 2x a day for a few weeks now, and it helps calm any sensitivity, helps strengthen my skin barrier, and provides great hydration. I have acne prone, combination, dehydrated, sensitive skin, and it hasnt caused any acne whatsoever. It dries down pretty well and doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky. The only (minor) complaint I have is the dropper is a bit finicky sometimes and doesn't pick up any product and you have to try a few times. 10/10 otherwise!!

Wow! I tried this because I've had my eye on the brand for a while,bc of my love for centella asiatica. My face was very sensitive, inflamed & red. I took a chance & purchased this serum and was shocked at how well it worked: relieved redness, very soothing, moisturizing and healing. I'm so pleased, I'm back to order more products from this brand!

avis.titre: The Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule has be
avis.texte: The Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule has been a great addition to my skincare routine. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky, making it easy to use both morning and night. From the first few uses, my skin felt calmer and more hydrated, especially when it was feeling sensitive or irritated. Over time, I noticed less redness and my skin felt stronger and more balanced. The combination of Centella and Probio-Cica helps support the skin barrier while providing gentle hydration. My skin looks healthier, smoother, and more resilient overall. This ampoule works well for sensitive skin and is a great option for anyone looking to calm, repair, and strengthen their skin without irritation.

I absolutely loved this product! It felt so nice on my skin, not heavy at all! It also made my skin look so amazing and helped a lot with my red spots. I loved using this product and I highly recommend!

I found this serum on sale at Marshalls and decided impulse buy to save my last trip to ulta to get my usual "The Ordinary" serums. My skin feels so smooth and soft after using this. It feels like my skin has been reborn. I struggle with sensitive skin and eczema so i was extremely impressed. This will be in my routine in the long run.

Thanks to Skin1004 or the free Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule! Tried the Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule for two weeks and overall it was good. I could feel the hydrating effect and my skin felt more comfortable and moisturized, especially after cleansing. I didn't see a huge difference in the appearance of my pores in that time, but the consistency is really nice, not too thick or too thin, and it layers well under moisturizer. Bonus points for having no scent, which I really appreciate for daily use.

avis.titre: A must in my skincare routine
avis.texte: I first had no idea what an ampule was versus a serum. Once I added it to my routine, my skin felt so much more hydrated and softer than when I was using just a serum. I have very dry skin and this along with all of the essences and creams I'm using makes me feel like my skin barrier is protected and I'm ready for winter. The bottle is such a generous size too! Received for free in exchange for a review, and I'll buy it again when I run out.

I received a sample of this in exchange for my honest review: At first, I was really impressed with the packaging and bottle itself. I've used this for four weeks now and I already have another bottle on the way! It's not dramatic results within days, it's subtle and almost immediately you looked hydrated and have some flush back in your skin. The scent is nice and subtle nothing overpowering. It feels light and silky on, not heavy and suffocating on the skin. It's been. A great staple to my skin routine!

I love this product. I have a a lot of actives so this is great for restoring my skin barrier without leaving it feeling oily or too heavy. I also appreciate that it doesn't have any fragrance, which is great for sensitive skin.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product
avis.texte: After weeks of using it, I've noticed a great improvement in my blemishes and my skin looks much more radiant. As someone prone to acne, this product has never caused me any breakouts..

The Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule is a solid step up from basic centella serums or hydrating products. It strikes a nice balance of soothing, nourishing, and non-greasy, making it especially worth trying if calming and barrier support are priorities in your routine. Please disclose that you received this product as part of a free sample program.

I did really like the consistency of this serum, it was almost a mix of a milky toner and an essence. I think it really did help with my hydration, especially in the colder months. I do think it's lightweight enough though would still be nice to make you feel hydrated in the summer for a nice dew! Would need to use it longer to see how it will be helpful with skincare. Overall nice product!
I started using this product to help improve and make my skin healthier. It has made my skin firmer and it has more elasticity.i love the smell as well. It is really a great product.

I received this product in exchange for an honest review. I love this serum!! I have very dry and easily irritated skin and I started using this product just as my city started getting really cold. This serum is super lightweight and sinks in instantly. Not stick under makeup. I can absolutely tell that my skin is more hydrated and supple throughout the day but it's not greasy or oily. I highly recommend this ampoule, especially if you have dry skin.

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. This is my first time trying this brand and I am impressed by this ampule. Upon first use, I noticed brighter more radiant skin. Overtime, I haven't noticed a drastic difference, but I'm happy with this hydrated radiant look.
I love how light this feels on my skin. It has essentially no smell to me and feels very natural overall. I noticed some reduction in redness.

I like to use this serum at night on days opposite of my retinol because it is so soothing and hydrating. It is packed ingredients that help support a strong skin barrier. My skin feels so nice after using it. Thank you to Skin1004 and bzzagent for giving me this product for free in exchange for my honest review!

avis.titre: Love this for my skincare routine
avis.texte: I received this product for free to try out, and I've honestly really liked it. The Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule feels super calming the second I put it on, and it's helped a lot with redness and dryness. It's lightweight, sinks in fast, and makes my skin look smoother and more even. I'd definitely consider buying it and would recommend it to anyone with sensitive or easily irritated skin.

I have been using this product for a couple weeks now as part of my regular daily skin care routine. I use Tret nightly, and many people might know that can cause very dry skin spots! In the morning I rinse my face off and follow up with the centella probio-cica intensive ampoule along with a bit of moisturizer with spf and it helps my skin to feel super smooth and moisturized. I did notice after the first week that daily application was causing some breakouts for me, so I reduced it to applying every other morning and that has cleared up my issue. I would definitely recommend this product since my skin is feeling so nice now and it doesn't feel heavy or greasy.

The texture is nice and helps with moisturizing. I use it after my toner and before another layer of cream to lock it all in. I do wish it had suggested usage for newbies who may not have used something like this before. Very affordable too! Received for free from BzzAgent

I've been using the Madagascar Probio‑Cica Intensive Ampoule and it has quickly become my go‑to skincare essential. My skin used to be reactive and easily irritated, but this ampoule helped calm everything down while strengthening my barrier. The texture is silky and absorbs fast, leaving my face hydrated without heaviness or stickiness. I appreciate that it's fragrance‑free, which makes it gentle enough for daily use. After consistent application, my complexion looks smoother, redness has faded, and my skin feels healthier overall. Even when I get the occasional breakout, they're less intense than before. The packaging feels premium, and the dropper makes it easy to apply.
This ampoule irritated my skin, made my cheeks all red and i felt no hydration, i have dry sensitive skin. I think my skin just doesnt like fermented ingredients
I love this product! The Ampoule leaves my skin soft and radiant !

avis.titre: Very hydrating ampoule for dry skin
avis.texte: Centella kindly sent me this Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule for free so that I could review it. As a woman with dry skin, I thoroughly enjoyed how hydrating this ampoule was. The packaging feels very luxe and the product itself was very rich. I found myself naturally reaching for this product over others already in my skin care routine. I will definitely be recommending this to others and repurchasing myself.

I've heard a lot about the Skin1004 brand before and i also knew that their Centella ampoule was really famous. So when it was time to buy new skincare products, I decided to try this one. Since this was my first time purchasing a Skin1004 product, I was a bit worried about whether it would suit me, but thankfully I'm using it really well!! First of all, the product has a watery and very hydrating texture that spreads easily. Because of that, it applies smoothly and you can layer it nicely on the skin My skin is moisture-deficient combination skin, basically combination skin that feels dry or tight. So I really need to maintain a good oil–moisture balance and I think this product helps with that and relieves dryness well. It's my first time using this product, but so far I'm very satisfied and using it well~!!!

I've tried a lot of soothing serums, but the SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule is one of the few that actually does what it promises without feeling heavy or sticky. Compared to other calming products I've used, this one is lighter, absorbs fast (within 30 seconds, with no shine and just pleasantly hydrated skin), and somehow manages to make my skin look like I slept more than 5 hours (a true miracle)!! It calms irritation, hydrates without suffocating my face, and makes my skin feel less cranky after retinoids… and the skin barrier healing properties are particularly welcome during this cold front. It's basically skincare emotional support in a bottle. Would I buy it again? Absolutely - although I apparently no longer own my bottle because my SO tried it once and immediately stole it. See photos for before and afters (wrinkles from dehydration reduced after just 1 wk of use)! Skin1004 kindly gave me this Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule for free so that I could review it.

I love that Madagascar centella intensive Ampoule. It moisturizes well my skin and it is perfect for my dry and sensitive skin. I love the positive results and the hydrating glow results. Very good ingredients too. " Skin1004 sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program."

I have been using this Ampoule for a few days so far and I have to admit that since the first moment i used it I could feel instant hydration and this amazing glow to my skin. I have been using other products for months and this one instantly did what i have been looking for in the other products ive been using. I have combined skin with noticeable pores and this has already helped me reduce the look by tightening them and the best part of all, it does not leave my skin feeling sticky after applying. Must try to see for yourself what wonders this product does.

This product has made such a big difference in my skincare routine. It's a thin milky serum texture, absorbs very quickly, and is deeply hydrating. I put it on right after washing my face, and then I put my usual moisturizer on top of it afterwards. It's made my skin barrier better than ever and also has been a big help during these colder months. It also does not disturb any products that I put on over it like makeup. I was also very impressed with the packaging. The bottle is glass and the top is a dropper. It feels luxe and high-end.

Having received this product for review from BzzAgent and Skin1004 I was blown away at the quality. The glass bottle is very sturdy and the product itself you can tell was carefully designed. it's a light weight but hydrating ampoule and I can see my skin looking firmer already. I would recommend this to anyone needing a skin pick me up!
I love how this product made my skin feel. I received compliments of how healthy my face looked while using it.
The formula is very hydrating, non-sticky, and it soaks into the skin well. The texture is smooth and lightweight also. By the end of the day, my skin still feels hydrated and nourished ñ.
Love the way it feels on my skin. Been using for almost a week at night time

Perfect addition to my skincare routine. Leaves my skin feeling super soft and plump. I'm very prone to breakouts and this is one of the very few products that has not caused irritation. I've recommended it to all my friends and family. Would definitely buy again!

Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule Leaves, skin filling, very smooth. It has a calming effect on the skin and you can tell that it is nutrient dense. I was surprised by how reasonably priced the items are I would definitely purchase some additional products from this skin care.

avis.titre: Hydrating and restoring without the stickiness
avis.texte: I love the packaging, design, and the ingredients that don't irritate my skin, leaves my skin feeling hydrated, and works well my skincare routine. I definitely recommend this for anyone looking to restore your skin's barrier and keep a healthy glow.

I received this product as part of a free sample program, but this is my honest review! I have used the skin 1004 tone brightening ampoule before and it worked really well so I was excited to get this. My skin is very dry due to being on a retinoid, and my cheeks are visibly red because of skin barrier damage. I have been using this for nearly a week now and the redness on my face has lessened significantly. I still have some dry patches on my forehead and between my brows, but this has helped keep the flaking from worsening. I haven't had any breakouts so far, but I would always recommend patch testing first. I patch tested ony my arm to see if the spot would get itchy or would react differently, but none so far. The serum absorbs quickly and isn't sticky or greasy so it is also good to use in the morning before going out. I would recommend this product to anyone suffering from skin barrier damage as long as you are not allergic to any ingredients in this serum.

A few days in,and this product has won me over. The hydration is fantastic. I also noticed it calms the sensitive areas on my face almost immediately. As a longtime sufferer of seborrheic dermatitis, finding something this effective yet gentle is a game-changer. Plus, the presentation is top-notch, and the tube is generously sized. Highly recommended!

The consistency is milky and creamy not greasy, Lightweight. After using it I've noticed less redness and irritation, more balanced skin barrier. It's calming down my irritated skin. The texture is lightweight, non-sticky, it absorbs very quickly. It's gentle, effective. It's deep moisturizing formula that well hydrates my dry skin. I received this product free in exchange for my review.

Thanks skin1004 for this free product! I'm so impressed with this product! It layers effortlessly with other products and didn't cause any breakouts. My skin is glowing the next morning everytime I use this.

avis.titre: A Gentle Reset for Irritated Skin!
avis.texte: Lightweight, calming, and perfect for sensitive skin days. This ampoule absorbs quickly without any stickiness, but still gives that deep, soothing hydration my skin needs. After using it consistently, I've noticed less redness and a stronger, more balanced skin barrier. It's gentle, effective, and fits so easily into my routine—especially when my skin feels stressed or irritated. 💚✨

I haven't used this product long enough to see a difference. But I will say I do love the way my face feels after using it. It has a smooth consistency, and doesn't leave my skin feeling oily. If you are looking for a product to boost your skincare I'd say give this a try!

Thank you, skin1004 for sending it for free to try. My skin feels so much better after the first try, i have combo skin and it feels so nourishing and hydrated. I've been using it for a few days now and I won't be stopping anytime soon. I will definitely be purchasing once I run out.

I'm beyond impressed with this product! From the very first use, it delivers a soothing, cooling sensation that instantly reduces redness and irritation. The texture is lightweight, non-sticky, and absorbs beautifully. What makes this ampoule exceptional is the combination of Centella Asiatica extract and Probio-Cica, which helps strengthen the skin barrier over time. After a few weeks, my skin felt noticeably more resilient, hydrated, and balanced. Breakouts healed faster, and my overall complexion looked calmer and healthier. It layers effortlessly with other products and works even on my extremely sensitive skin. If you're looking for a gentle yet effective solution to soothe inflammation, boost hydration, and repair your skin barrier, this ampoule is absolutely worth it. Highly recommended!

This is a great milky serum. My skin love fermented ingredients in skincare and drank this up. It was hydrating and nourishing, and I feel that with long term use it will be great for healing the barrier. I received a sample of this to review, but would definitely repurchase.
I would apply this ampoule after cleansing my face and putting on my thinner toners. It would make my face look glowy, plump, and stay hydrated throughout the day. This product is a must have.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this again!
avis.texte: I love being able to receive and try new items and this sample did not disappoint! being able to try a brand I wasn't aware of gave me knowledge of something in the future
Such an easy milky ampoule. This is my second bottle and still love it

I love it...It has a calming effect. Today I had some dryness and irritation around my eyes, I used this product and it feel so fresh and calming. Its sensitive skin approved and gave me so much glow... 100% recomend.

avis.titre: Milky Ampoule leaves skin plump and hydrated
avis.texte: This milky ampoule is very creamy. It sinks into the skin and instantly pumps and hydrates it. It penetrates through every later to give a glass skin glow. I love how it calms and moisturizers my skin at the same time.My pores are minimized and the texture is improved. My fine lines vanished too. It is also nice as a pre makeup primer to boost your skin. I got a sample to try and recommend it
This serum is awesome. So hydrating and plumping. You get 3 oz of product too so very good value.

Purchased this product because I damaged my skin barrier. I have combination, acne prone, & sensitive skin. This product is super hydrating, and I love the thickness of it. A little goes a long way. Product did not irritate my compromised skin. LOVE!

I have been dealing with skin barrier issues, hormonal acne, and rosacea. This had helped more than any other product. I use it after my Skin1004 ampoule foam and anua rice toner. Amazing product and I cannot recommend it enough!!!

Sinks into skin flawlessly and is immediately calming. It is a serum-almost-gel consistency and is scent free. I think the amount you receive for the price is a good deal if you like Korean skincare. This would be great for sensitive skin and to rebuild your skin barrier.
